subject: Dedicated capacity performance validation - SLO & sizing follow-up
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Dedicated capacity SLOs, target sizing, next steps

Hi Lisa - thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned:  

Summary of requirements you shared:
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 150ms for 512-token generation (interactive customer flows)
- Throughput: sustained 500 RPS at 512-token median request size (burst to 800 RPS)
- Concurrent users: expected 200 active concurrent streams during peak
- Streaming: yes - streaming responses needed for partial tokens to the client
- Model: plan to use an open decoder model (approx 70B) with quantized weights
- Data/ISV constraints: single-tenant dedicated pool, SOC2 evidence required for procurement

Immediate asks from FintechCo:
1) A sizing recommendation for Dedicated capacity (GPU type + node count) to meet the SLOs above
2) A short benchmark plan comparing A100-80GB vs H100-80GB (or similar) for latency & steady-state throughput
3) Confirmation on reserved throughput guarantees and fallback behavior if reserved is saturated

What we'll deliver by EOD Friday (proposed):
- Initial sizing estimate (nodes + expected reserved throughput)
- Benchmark plan with test vectors and metrics we will collect (p50/p95 latency, tail latency, tokens/sec, connection concurrency, streaming latency)
- Short POA for SOC2 evidence handoff and procurement contacts

Attachments: redwood_sla-metrics.csv (sample metrics format), dedicated-config-proposal.pdf (initial sizing sketch)

Next steps / owners:
- Rafael: own benchmark plan, coordinate test run with Aditya
- Aditya: run microbenchmarks on both GPU types and share raw traces
- Marissa: lead procurement / SOC2 artifacts and pricing proposal

Does this timeline work for you? Any additional constraints we should include in the benchmark (e.g., multi-region, encryption in transit metrics)?

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_sla-metrics.csv (csv, 45KB)]
[Attachment: dedicated-config-proposal.pdf (pdf, 230KB)]

From: Lisa Chen <lisa@fintechco.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Dedicated capacity SLOs, target sizing, next steps

Thanks Rafael - that looks great. Couple clarifications from our side:
- The 512 tokens number is typical but we do have some analytic workflows that generate 1,024 tokens occasionally; please include a brief note on how that impacts sizing (p95 target can relax to 250ms for those batch-like workflows).
- We will need TLS + customer-managed KMS for keys; please flag anything that would affect benchmark results (e.g., CPU crypto overhead).
- Procurement note: our security team will request SOC2 Type II evidence and audit logs retention details; Marissa, I'll loop in our procurement lead (cc'd on later threads) if needed.

Happy with the EOD Friday deliverable. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lisa
VP Engineering | FintechCo

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Benchmark plan & requested data for FintechCo (internal)

Aditya / Marissa - following Lisa's clarifications, here's the plan I discussed we should run:  

Benchmark goals:
- Validate p95 <= 150ms @512 tokens on candidate GPU types (A100-80GB, H100-80GB) for a 70B quantized model variant
- Measure sustained throughput (tokens/sec) and achieved RPS under concurrency profiles (200 concurrent streams, bursts to 800 RPS)
- Verify streaming latency (first-byte and inter-token gaps) under real network emulation (50ms RTT, 1% packet loss)
- Evaluate impact of TLS + KMS on CPU utilization and token latency

Test matrix (high level):
- GPUs: A100-80GB, H100-80GB
- Node configs: 1 GPU / 2 GPU / 4 GPU pool sizes to estimate horizontal scaling curves
- Batch sizes: dynamic batching with target latency cap, and forced batch windows for throughput testing
- Payloads: 256 tokens, 512 tokens, 1,024 tokens
- Metrics to collect: p50/p95/p99 latency (generation and first-byte), tokens/sec, GPU util, host CPU, mem, network, KV cache hit rate

Deliverables:
- Raw traces + summary dashboard (CSV and lightweight Grafana snapshot)
- Recommended reserved throughput (RPS) per node size and a final node count for the 500 RPS sustained target with headroom for burst
- Notes on expected billing impact and suggested fallback policies (model-throttle to cheaper quantized variant, redirect to hosted tier)

Can you run the initial microbenchmarks on our internal test cluster and push results to the shared Drive folder by EOD Friday? Aditya, please prioritize the A100 vs H100 latency runs for 512 tokens first. Marissa, please pull SOC2 artifact checklist and pricing reference for a 12-month reserved commitment - I'll use that in the proposal to FintechCo.

Thanks - Rafael

[Internal note: keep results segmented by region even though the customer is single-region today]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Benchmark plan & requested data for FintechCo (internal)

Quick status update:  
- Aditya: A100 1-GPU latency run for 512 tokens started this morning; initial samples show p95 ~ 165ms (we are tuning kernel selection and batching window to shave ~10-15ms). Will run H100 next and share raw CSVs.
- SOC2 artifacts: I have the Type II report stub and audit-log retention statement ready to share with Lisa's procurement; will add to the Drive folder.
- Pricing: drafting a 12-month reserved proposal with two sizing options (conservative and aggressive) - will include expected per-token cost and note on burst capacity pricing.

Next internal steps before we send a customer-facing note:
1) Complete A100 vs H100 microbenchmarks for 256/512/1024 tokens (Aditya)
2) Build a short summary slide (1-2 slides) with recommended node count + expected p95 at target load (Rafael / Marissa)
3) Confirm TLS+KMS test run to measure CPU crypto impact (Aditya)

I'll assemble a customer-ready summary once Aditya uploads traces to the Drive. Rafael - want me to include the pricing/options in the same email to Lisa or send pricing as a separate follow-up?

-Marissa
